name: Refresher
description: Reset the cooldown of all your abilities and restore all your charges.

name: Witchmail
description: Taking heavy hits of spirit damage from an enemy reduces a random ability cooldown.

name: Spirit Strike
description: When you perform a Light or Heavy Melee attack against a hero, deal extra spirit damage with the attack and reduce the target's Spirit Resist.Cooldown is 2x longer for Light Melee hits.

name: Active Reload
description: While reloading, pressing Reload during the highlighted portion will instantly finish your reload and grant you Fire Rate, Bullet Lifesteal and Move Speed.

name: Armor Piercing Rounds
description: Your Bullets have a chance to become unavoidable, piercing through enemies and ignoring their Bullet Resistance.

name: Duration Extender
description: Imbue an ability to increase its Duration.

name: Arcane Surge
description: After you Dash-Jump, the next ability you use within 7s will have bonus Range, Duration, and Spirit Power.

name: Arctic Blast
description: Release an expanding ice blast that deals spirit damage, Freezing and then Slowing targets it hits.Slowed targets have their stamina regen frozen

name: Crippling Headshot
description: Landing a Headshot will reduce their Bullet and Spirit Resist and applies Healing Reduction.

name: Berserker
description: Your Weapon Damage increases as you take sustained damage.

name: Blood Tribute
description: Toggle: Continually sacrifice Health to improve fire rate, Debuff Resistance and Move Speed.

name: Lifestrike
description: Your Melee Attack applies Movement Slow and heals you for a percentage of the Melee Damage dealt plus a fixed amount. This heal is 40% effective vs non-heroes. Cooldown is 1.5x as long for Light Melee hits.

name: Hunter's Aura
description: Reduces nearby enemies' Bullet Resist and Fire Rate. If there is only one enemy hero nearby, this effect is doubled.

name: Bullet Resist Shredder
description: Reduces Bullet Resist on enemies when you deal spirit damage.

name: Ballistic Enchantment
description: Imbue an ability with increased range. Dealing damage with that ability grants you increased weapon damage per unique hero hit. Has reduced effect on non-heroes.

name: Burst Fire
description: Briefly gain Fire Rate and Move Speed when one of your bullets hits an enemy hero.

name: Capacitor
description: Launch a projectile that deals damage, applies a strong slow that recovers over time, prevents Stamina usage and Silences their movement-based items and abilities.

name: Enduring Speed
description: Reduces the effect of enemy Move Speed penalties.

name: Celestial Blessing
description: Applies an extremely powerful cleanse that replenishes your allies globally.

name: Tesla Bullets
description: Your bullets have a chance to shock your target. The shock will jump to a nearby enemy.

name: Fortitude
description: After not taking damage for a period, gain health regen.

name: Cloak of Opportunity
description: Block the next debuff that would apply movement lock, Stun, Chained, Immobilize, or Sleep and become Unstoppable. Also gain a Barrier and bonus move speed

name: Shadow Weave
description: Become Stealthed. Whenever you take damage while Stealthed you get briefly revealed.

name: Point Blank
description: When in close range to your target, gain Weapon Damage and your bullets apply a Movement Slow.

name: Close Quarters
description: Deal additional Weapon Damage when in close range to your target.

name: Cold Front
description: Release an expanding ice blast that deals spirit damage and Slows targets it hits.

name: Colossus
description: Grow larger in size, gaining bullet resist, spirit resist, and melee damage. Nearby enemies suffer from slow and have reduced dash speed.

name: Slowing Hex
description: Slows movement of enemy target. Also Silences their movement-based items and abilities.Increases the target's gravity.Does not affect target's stamina usage.

name: Superior Cooldown
description: Reduces the Cooldown of your abilities.

name: Counterspell
description: Your next parry protects you from the damage and effects of enemy abilities and items. On a successful spell parry heal and gain move speed and Spirit.

name: Mystic Shot
description: Your next bullet deals bonus spirit damage.

name: Lucky Shot
description: Your bullets have a chance to be empowered, causing them to deal bonus weapon damage on hit.Bonus damage cannot Crit.

name: Crushing Fists
description: Your melee damage will restore ammo and apply a stacking bullet resist debuff on enemies. Heavy melee applies 2 stacks. If the target reaches max stacks, they will be stunned.

name: Leech
description: Reduces the effect of enemy applied healing reduction.

name: Debuff Reducer
description: Reduces the duration of all negative effects applied to you.

name: Plated Armor
description: Gain a chance to either deflect incoming bullets, preventing all weapon damage or prevent all on-hit effects from bullets.

name: Scourge
description: Apply Spirit Resist, Debuff Resist and an aura on a friendly target that deals damage to enemies proportional to their max health. Existing debuffs on the target are reduced.Can be self cast.

name: Divine Barrier
description: Remove all non-stun debuffs from the target and provide them with a Barrier and Move Speed. Can be self-cast. Cooldown is reduced by half when cast on someone else.

name: Diviner's Kevlar
description: Upon casting an ultimate ability gain a Barrier and temporary Spirit Power.

name: Heroic Aura
description: Provides Bullet Resist to nearby friendly units.

name: Haunting Shot
description: Your next bullet applies a powerful debuff reducing the enemy's damage output, healing and movement speed. It also deals bonus spirit damage based on the targets current Health. The bullet is larger and penetrates through targets.

name: Electric Slippers
description: When sliding, evade bullets, gain fire rate and deal damage to enemies around you. Cooldown is per target.

name: Spellslinger
description: While in-combat whenever you cast an ability or item, gain a stacking buff that improves fire rate and reload speed. Each stack refreshes the duration.

name: Escalating Exposure
description: Dealing spirit damage applies a stacking Spirit Amp that increases your spirit damage to the target.

name: Eternal Gift
description: Periodically gain a random permanent stat buff.

name: Mercurial Magnum
description: Your imbued ability charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, bonus fire rate, and reloads bullets on use. Until your next reload, your bullets deal bonus spirit damage based on your Spirit Power.

name: Express Shot
description: Your next attack will fire twice in quick succession with increased damage and velocity. This attack consumes extra ammo.

name: Focus Lens
description: Target an enemy to Silence them. A portion of all damage dealt during the silence gets applied to the target when the silence wears off.

name: Glass Cannon
description: Each hero kill grants permanent Fire Rate (up to a max of 8 times). Death results in the loss of 1 stack.

name: Cursed Relic
description: Curses an enemy - interrupting, Silencing, Disarming, and preventing item usage. Removes all non-ultimate buffs.Your own Damage Output is reduced for the duration.

name: Golden Goose Egg
description: Gain souls over time, as long as you are alive.

name: Disarming Hex
description: Disarms enemy target and reduces their Bullet Resist.

name: Grit
description: Gain a Barrier for a short duration.

name: Guardian Ward
description: Provide the target with a Barrier and temporary Move Speed. Can be self-cast.Cooldown is reduced by half when cast on someone else.

name: Headhunter
description: Your next headshot against an enemy Hero deals bonus weapon damage, heal you, and briefly grants bonus move speed.

name: Headshot Booster
description: Your next headshot against an enemy Hero deals bonus weapon damage.

name: Weakening Headshot
description: Landing a Headshot reduces their Bullet Resist.

name: Healbane
description: Your spirit damage applies Healing Reduction. If an enemy hero dies under this effect, you receive a large heal.

name: Healing Tempo
description: Applying heal to yourself or an ally grants the target bonus fire rate and bonus move speed.Does not apply on innate Regen or passive Bullet/Spirit Lifesteals.

name: Healing Booster
description: Increases the effectiveness of your healing.

name: Healing Nova
description: Heal yourself and nearby allies.

name: Healing Rite
description: Grant Regen and Sprint Speed to the target. Gets dispelled if you take damage from enemy players or objectives. Can be self-cast.

name: Hollow Point
description: When you are above 65% health, deal additional Weapon Damage and your bullets reduce enemy Bullet Resist.

name: Seraphim Wings
description: When Airborne, You deal more damage and take reduced damage. Allows unlimited Air Dash and Jumping.

name: Superior Duration
description: Increases the duration of your abilities and items.

name: Bullet Resilience
description: When below 50% health, gain additional Bullet Resist.

name: Infinite Rounds
description: You have infinite ammo.

name: Infuser
description: Gain Spirit Lifesteal and Spirit Power.

name: Inhibitor
description: Your bullets build up to reduce the target's outgoing damage and apply healing reduction.

name: Intensifying Magazine
description: Increases Weapon Damage as you continuously fire your weapon.

name: Kinetic Dash
description: When you Dash-Jump you gain Fire Rate and bonus Ammo until your next reload. Lasts up to 7s.

name: Melee Lifesteal
description: Your next Melee attack heals you. This heal is 30% effective vs non-heroes. Cooldown is 1.5x as long for Light Melee hits.

name: Long Range
description: Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.

name: Mystic Burst
description: Charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, causing abilities dealing more than 80 damage to deal additional damage.

name: Magic Carpet
description: Summon a Magic Carpet that will fly you away. While flying you are immune to slows and doing any action will dismiss the carpet. Cannot use abilities while the carpet is being summoned.

name: Mystic Expansion
description: Imbue an ability to increase its range and effect radius.

name: Enchanter's Emblem
description: While you are above 65% health, gain bonus Spirit and Cooldown Reduction.

name: Tankbuster
description: Charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, causing abilities dealing more than 165 damage to deal additional damage. Ignores Spirit Resistance.

name: Mystic Slow
description: When the target takes spirit damage, they have their Move Speed reduced.

name: Surge of Power
description: Imbue an ability with permanent Spirit Power. When that ability is used, gain bonus Move Speed and maintain full speed while attacking.

name: Compress Cooldown
description: Imbue an ability to reduce its Cooldown.

name: Mystic Vulnerability
description: When an enemy takes spirit damage, they have their spirit resist reduced.

name: Restorative Shot
description: Your next bullet will heal you based on what target you hit.

name: Melee Charge
description: Your next Heavy Melee attack against an enemy deals increased damage.

name: Rebuttal
description: On a successful Parry against an enemy Hero, Heal yourself for the damage parried and returns that damage to the target, and temporarily gain increased damage.

name: Metal Skin
description: Become immune to bullets.

name: Mystic Regeneration
description: Dealing spirit damage to enemy Heroes grants you Bonus regeneration. Stacks when dealing damage to different heroes.

name: Mystical Piano
description: After a short delay, enemies in the target area will be stunned and have their stamina depleted. After the stun they will be temporarily dazed.

name: Cultist Sacrifice
description: Target an enemy NPC and consume it for 180% Bonus Souls and grants a powerful long lasting buff.

name: Nullification Burst
description: Removes any positive buffs and prevents stamina usage and healing effects on enemies.

name: Omnicharge Signet
description: Imbue any active non-ultimate ability with Bonus Ability Charges. Already charged abilities receive more bonus charges.

name: Mystic Conduit
description: Provides yourself and allies with a powerful spirit focused aura. Has reduced values on allies.

name: Phantom Strike
description: Teleport to an enemy target and pull them to the ground. Dealing damage, Move speed reduction and Disarm.

name: Prism Blast
description: You enter a void state and become untargetable and invincible for a short duration, during which lasers blast out and rotate around you.

name: Opening Rounds
description: Your attacks have additional Weapon Damage against enemies above 50% health.

name: Silencer
description: Your bullets build up to a Silence. Victims are immune to the build up for 10s after silence expires.

name: Quicksilver Reload
description: Your imbued ability charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, bonus fire rate, and reloads bullets on use.

name: Recharging Rush
description: Dealing significant weapon damage replenishes a charge for each of your charged abilities.

name: Battle Vest
description: While you are above 65% health, gain weapon damage and bonus fire rate.

name: Escalating Resilience
description: Grants Bullet Resist when your bullets hit an enemy hero. Each shot can only grant one stack.

name: Rescue Beam
description: Heals a target allied hero and yourself for a percentage of Max Health. Once while healing, you can Pull the target towards you. Can be self-cast.

name: Radiant Regeneration
description: Heal and gain bonus Movement Speed for a short duration when you cast an ability.

name: Return Fire
description: Automatically fire a bullet towards any attacker who damages you with their abilities or weapon.

name: Ricochet
description: Your bullets will ricochet on enemies near your target, applying any bullet procs and dealing a percentage of the original damage.

name: Majestic Leap
description: Launch yourself high into the air and grant yourself a Barrier. While in the air, you can use the active again to drop down faster.Cannot be used for 5s if attacked by enemy Hero.

name: Runed Gauntlets
description: Everytime you land a heavy melee, your existing cooldowns get reduced.

name: Decay
description: Inflict damage over time to a target, dealing damage based on their current health.Decay's damage is non-lethal and does not apply item procs.

name: Ethereal Shift
description: You enter a void state and become untargetable and invincible for a short duration, during which you float slowly and cannot perform actions. Afterwards you gain Spirit Power, Move Speed, and Spirit Resist.Can be canceled early.Activation cancels any active ability.

name: Shadow Strike
description: Go Invisible on Stamina use with no detection range. Doing a melee attack while invisible will cause you to steal bullet and spirit resistance from them and deal damage over time.

name: Sharpshooter
description: Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.

name: Frostbite Charm
description: Imbued ability has its Cooldown reduced and gains Spirit Power. When the ability deals damage, freeze the target and apply bonus damage. Cooldown is per target.

name: Shrink Ray
description: Reduces Model Size and grants Move Speed to the target. Allows usage of tunnels in this mode. Can be self-cast.

name: Slowing Bullets
description: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.

name: Spellbreaker
description: The next instance of high spirit damage you take is significantly reduced.

name: Spirit Shielding
description: Gain a Barrier whenever you take significant spirit damage from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.

name: Spirit Burn
description: Dealing significant spirit damage to an enemy within 5s causes an explosion dealing damage and a burn to that enemy. While burning, enemies take damage over time and receive reduced healing.The cooldown is per enemy, so each target can only be burned once per cooldown. Deals half-damage on non-heroes.

name: Spirit Sap
description: Target an enemy to reduce their Spirit Resist and Spirit Power.

name: Spirit Snatch
description: When you perform a Light or Heavy Melee attack against a hero, the attack deals extra spirit damage and steals Spirit Resist and Spirit Power.Effects are reduced by 30% for Light Melee hits.

name: Split Shot
description: Make your weapon fire multishot. Hitting more than one Hero per attack will grant a stacking weapon damage bonus. Targets can only be hit once per multishot.

name: Suppressor
description: When you deal spirit damage to enemies, you also reduce their Fire Rate.

name: Knockdown
description: Apply a Stun after 2s. Stun duration is increased against airborne targets.Increases the target's gravity for the duration of the stun.

name: Silence Wave
description: Launch an expanding projectile which Silences enemies for a short duration and deals impact damage. Silence does not interrupt channeling abilities.

name: Torment Pulse
description: Periodically deals spirit damage to the closest two enemies nearby.

name: Spirit Shredder Bullets
description: Your bullets apply a debuff that reduces the Spirit Resist of the target and grants you and your allies Spirit Lifesteal against them.

name: Spiritual Overflow
description: Gain bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Spirit Lifesteal by charging up when shooting enemy heroes.

name: Spirit Resilience
description: When below 50% health, gain additional Spirit Resist.

name: Greater Expansion
description: Increases the range and effect radius of your abilities and items.

name: Alchemical Fire
description: Throw a flask that explodes on contact, creating an area that does increasing spirit damage per second and reduces enemy Bullet Resist.50% less effective vs non-heroes.

name: Toxic Bullets
description: Your bullets build up a Bleed on enemies, causing them to lose a percentage of their Max Health over time. Also applies Healing Reduction on the bleeding target.

name: Transcendent Cooldown
description: Reduces the Cooldown of your abilities and items.

name: Trophy Collector
description: Whenever you score an assist or kill, gain extra sprint, ability range and passive soul generation. This effect stacks and persists through death.

name: Lightning Scroll
description: Damage from your ultimate applies a stun and deals bonus spirit damage after a short delay.

name: Unstable Concoction
description: Consume a concoction that grants you Unstoppable and increased speed, health, spirit and weapon damage. After a short duration you die and explode, stunning nearby enemies and dealing damage based on your maximum health. Dying this way reduces your respawn time by 50%.

name: Unstoppable
description: Temporarily suppress negative status effects and become immune to Stun, Silence, Sleep, Root, and Disarm. Cannot be used while Stunned or Slept.

name: Veil Walker
description: Walking through a cosmic veil grants you Stealth, Heal and increased Move Speed.

name: Reactive Barrier
description: Gain a Barrier when you are Stunned, Chained, Immobilized, Slept or Silenced.

name: Warp Stone
description: Teleport straight ahead, gaining Bullet Resist.

name: Stalker
description: Dealing weapon damage at close range opens a wound and grants you bonus move speed. Wounded enemies take spirit damage over time, have reduced bullet resist, and are revealed through walls.

name: Weapon Shielding
description: Gain a Barrier whenever you take significant weapon damage from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.

name: Weighted Shots
description: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.

name: Rusted Barrel
description: Target an enemy to reduce their Fire Rate and Bullet Resistance.
